coreMemory.chinese: 卖；出售；销售；卖得；说服；推销
coreMemory.english: v. to give goods or property in exchange for money；v. to be bought in a particular quantity or manner；v. to persuade someone to accept an idea or proposal
coreMemory.structure: sell a house /ˈsɛl ə ˈhaʊs/（出售房屋）；sell a product /ˈsɛl ə ˈprɑdəkt/（销售产品）；sell tickets /ˈsɛl ˈtɪkəts/（售票）；sell online /ˈsɛl ˈɔːnˌlaɪn/（在线销售）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ He sold the laptop from me. → ✅ He sold the laptop to me.；❌ The shop sold the book me. → ✅ The shop sold the book to me.

commonErrors.wrong: He sold the laptop from me.
commonErrors.right: He sold the laptop to me.
commonErrors.note: sell 表示卖给某人时用 to，from 表示来源。

commonErrors.wrong: The shop sold the book me.
commonErrors.right: The shop sold the book to me.
commonErrors.rightPhonetic: /ðə ˈʃɑp ˈsoʊld ðə ˈbʊk ˈtuː ˈmiː/
commonErrors.note: 物品位于人前时，要用 sell something to someone。

coreMemory.directSynonym: retail /ˈriːˌteɪl/（零售）；market /ˈmɑrkət/（营销）；trade /ˈtreɪd/（买卖）；auction /ˈɑkʃən/（拍卖）；persuade /pɚˈsweɪd/（说服）
coreMemory.directAntonym: buy /ˈbaɪ/（购买）；withdraw from sale /wɪðˈdrɔː ˈfrʌm ˈseɪl/（撤回出售；停止销售）；retain ownership of /rɪˈteɪn ˈoʊnɚˌʃɪp ˈʌv/（保留……的所有权）
coreMemory.exampleChinese: 他们在网上出售手工包。

meanings.english: to give goods or property in exchange for money
meanings.example: They sold their old car to a neighbor.
meanings.translation: 他们把旧车卖给了邻居。

meanings.english: to be bought in a particular quantity or manner
meanings.example: The new model sells well overseas.
meanings.translation: 新型号在海外卖得很好。

meanings.english: to persuade someone to accept an idea or proposal
meanings.example: She sold the plan to a skeptical committee.
meanings.translation: 她说服持怀疑态度的委员会接受了该计划。

items.chinese: 以低于标价的价格出售

items.chinese: 说服投资者接受这个想法

fixedPhrases.example: They sold their house after moving closer to their children.
fixedPhrases.translation: 他们搬到离孩子更近的地方后卖掉了房子。

fixedPhrases.example: The company sells its main product in more than thirty countries.
fixedPhrases.translation: 这家公司在三十多个国家销售其主打产品。

fixedPhrases.example: Volunteers sold tickets at the theater entrance.
fixedPhrases.translation: 志愿者在剧院入口处售票。

fixedPhrases.example: Many independent artists sell their work online.
fixedPhrases.translation: 许多独立艺术家在网上出售作品。

fixedPhrases.example: She restored the old cabinet and sold it at a profit.
fixedPhrases.translation: 她修复了旧橱柜，并将其卖出获利。

fixedPhrases.example: The rare manuscript will be sold at auction next month.
fixedPhrases.translation: 这份珍贵手稿将于下月拍卖。

fixedPhrases.example: The market sells loose tea by weight.
fixedPhrases.translation: 这家市场按重量出售散装茶叶。

fixedPhrases.example: The farm sells fresh eggs directly to customers.
fixedPhrases.translation: 这家农场把新鲜鸡蛋直接卖给顾客。

fixedPhrases.example: Tickets for the final concert sold out quickly.
fixedPhrases.translation: 最后一场音乐会的门票很快就售罄了。

fixedPhrases.example: Lightweight rain jackets sell well in this region.
fixedPhrases.translation: 轻便雨衣在这个地区很畅销。

fixedPhrases.example: The architect used a model to sell her idea to the council.
fixedPhrases.translation: 建筑师用模型说服市政委员会接受她的构想。

fixedPhrases.example: Detailed cost estimates helped sell the board on the expansion plan.
fixedPhrases.translation: 详细的成本估算说服董事会接受了扩建计划。

synonyms.difference: 指直接向消费者销售；sell 也可用于批发、房产或个人二手交易。
强调宣传推广，不等同于完成出售；sell 表示完成或尝试交易，market 只强调推广。
强调商业交换，可买也可卖；sell 只说明卖方行为，trade 还可表示买入或交换。
通过竞价方式出售；sell 不要求竞价，按固定价格出售也适用。
只对应 sell an idea 的比喻义

antonyms.usage: 在交易方向上相对，卖方 sell、买方 buy
只与 offer/sell an item 的在售义相对；withdraw from sale 表示决定不再出售同一物品。
只与 sell an asset 的所有权转移义相对；retain ownership of 表示继续拥有同一资产而不转让。

derivatives.note: 指出售商品、房产或服务的人或机构。
sell 的常用名词形式，常见于 for sale 和 on sale。
常见于 selling price 和 selling skills。
表示商品达到可销售状态或具有市场。

confusables.difference: cell 与 sell 同音但拼写和词义不同；sell 是动词“出售”。
sell /sɛl/ 表示出售；sail /seɪl/ 表示航行或帆，拼写相近但元音和含义不同。

coreMemory.chinese: 支持；帮助；供养；赞成；拥护；证实；为……提供依据；支撑；承重；资助；支撑物；支架
coreMemory.english: v. to help someone emotionally, practically, or financially；v. to approve of and encourage an idea, person, or cause；v. to provide evidence that shows a claim is true；v. to hold something up and bear its weight；n. help, encouragement, approval, or resources given to someone or something；n. a thing that holds an object up or bears its weight
coreMemory.structure: support a family /səˈpɔːrt ə ˈfæməli/（养活家庭）；support a proposal /səˈpɔːrt ə prəˈpoʊzəl/（支持提案）；support a claim /səˈpɔːrt ə ˈkleɪm/（为说法提供依据）；support a roof /səˈpɔːrt ə ˈruːf/（支撑屋顶）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ I strongly support to the proposal. → ✅ I strongly support the proposal.；❌ Her family supported to her during treatment. → ✅ Her family supported her during treatment.

commonErrors.wrong: I strongly support to the proposal.
commonErrors.note: support 是及物动词，直接接所支持的人或事。

commonErrors.wrong: Her family supported to her during treatment.
commonErrors.wrongPhonetic: /ˈhɝː ˈfæməli səˈpɔːrtɪd ˈtuː ˈhɝː ˈdʊrɪŋ ˈtriːtmənt/
commonErrors.right: Her family supported her during treatment.
commonErrors.note: support 作“支持某人”时直接接人，不在宾语前加 to。

coreMemory.directSynonym: help /ˈhɛlp/（帮助）；assist /əˈsɪst/（协助）；back /ˈbæk/（支持）；uphold /əpˈhoʊld/（维护）；sustain /səˈsteɪn/（支撑）
coreMemory.directAntonym: oppose /əˈpoʊz/（反对）；undermine /ˈʌndɚˌmaɪn/（削弱）；abandon /əˈbændən/（放弃支持；抛弃）
coreMemory.example: Her family supported her decision to study abroad.
coreMemory.exampleChinese: 她的家人支持她出国学习的决定。

meanings.english: to help someone emotionally, practically, or financially
meanings.example: Her family supported her through treatment.
meanings.translation: 她的家人在治疗期间一直支持她。

meanings.english: to approve of and encourage an idea, person, or cause
meanings.example: Most residents support the proposal.
meanings.translation: 大多数居民支持这项提案。

meanings.english: to provide evidence that shows a claim is true
meanings.example: The figures support our conclusion.
meanings.translation: 这些数据支持我们的结论。

meanings.english: to hold something up and bear its weight
meanings.example: Steel beams support the roof.
meanings.translation: 钢梁支撑着屋顶。

meanings.english: help, encouragement, approval, or resources given to someone or something
meanings.example: The project depends on public support.
meanings.translation: 这个项目依赖公众支持。

meanings.english: a thing that holds an object up or bears its weight
meanings.example: The shelf needs an extra support in the middle.
meanings.translation: 这个架子中间需要再加一个支撑。

fixedPhrases.example: She worked two jobs to support her family after the factory closed.
fixedPhrases.translation: 工厂关闭后，她做两份工作养家。

fixedPhrases.example: Most residents support the proposal for a new health clinic.
fixedPhrases.translation: 大多数居民支持新建医疗诊所的提案。

fixedPhrases.example: The photographs support his claim that the roof was already damaged.
fixedPhrases.translation: 这些照片支持他的说法，即屋顶此前就已损坏。

fixedPhrases.example: Four stone columns support the roof of the entrance hall.
fixedPhrases.translation: 四根石柱支撑着入口大厅的屋顶。

fixedPhrases.example: Several local unions supported the independent candidate.
fixedPhrases.translation: 几个当地工会支持这名独立候选人。

fixedPhrases.example: The concert raised money to support the cause of clean drinking water.
fixedPhrases.translation: 这场音乐会筹款支持清洁饮用水事业。

fixedPhrases.example: Data from three trials support the same conclusion.
fixedPhrases.translation: 三次试验的数据都支持同一个结论。

fixedPhrases.example: A specialist nurse supported the patient throughout her recovery.
fixedPhrases.translation: 一名专科护士在患者整个康复期间给予了帮助。

fixedPhrases.example: The festival encourages visitors to support local businesses.
fixedPhrases.translation: 这个节庆活动鼓励游客支持本地企业。

fixedPhrases.example: The new server can support a network of five hundred devices.
fixedPhrases.translation: 新服务器可以支撑一个由五百台设备组成的网络。

fixedPhrases.example: Reliable public transport supports economic development in rural areas.
fixedPhrases.translation: 可靠的公共交通促进农村地区的经济发展。

fixedPhrases.example: Her parents supported her financially during medical school.
fixedPhrases.translation: 她读医学院期间，父母在经济上支持她。

synonyms.difference: 最宽泛，可指实际帮助或改善处境；support 常含持续、情感或经济上的支持。
较正式，强调帮助完成任务；support 还可表示赞成立场、提供证据或承重。
常指公开或实际支持人、计划；support 比 back 范围广，也适用于结构和论据。
常指维护法律、原则或裁决；support 还可帮助个人或支撑物体，不限原则。
强调使结构、生命或活动持续；support 可指一次具体援助，也可指长期维持。

antonyms.usage: support 在观点、提案或候选人义上表示支持；oppose 表示明确反对同一对象，不适用于 support 的承重义。
对应支撑、维持或帮助某事的义项；support 使人或结构更稳固，undermine 则逐步削弱它。
只与 support a person/cause 的持续帮助义相对；abandon 表示停止帮助并离开同一对象。

derivatives.note: 指支持某人、组织、球队或观点的人。
常形容人、环境、评论或证据。
常见于 supporting evidence 和 supporting role。
可指结构没有支撑，也可指说法没有证据。

confusables.difference: support 是帮助或支撑，supply 是提供所需物品
support /səˈpɔːrt/ 表示支持或支撑；sport /spɔːrt/ 表示运动，拼写相近但音节数和含义不同。

coreMemory.structure: receive a message /rəˈsiːv ə ˈmɛsədʒ/（收到消息）；receive a letter from someone /rəˈsiːv ə ˈlɛtɚ ˈfrʌm ˈsʌmˌwʌn/（收到某人的来信）；receive payment /rəˈsiːv ˈpeɪmənt/（收到付款）；receive an award /rəˈsiːv ˈæn əˈwɔːrd/（获得奖项）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ I received a letter by my bank. → ✅ I received a letter from my bank.；❌ We received to your application yesterday. → ✅ We received your application yesterday.

commonErrors.wrong: I received a letter by my bank.
commonErrors.wrongPhonetic: /ˈaɪ rəˈsiːvd ə ˈlɛtɚ ˈbaɪ ˈmaɪ ˈbæŋk/
commonErrors.right: I received a letter from my bank.
commonErrors.rightPhonetic: /ˈaɪ rəˈsiːvd ə ˈlɛtɚ ˈfrʌm ˈmaɪ ˈbæŋk/
commonErrors.note: 表示发送者来源用 receive something from someone。

commonErrors.wrong: We received to your application yesterday.
commonErrors.note: receive 是及物动词，宾语前不加 to。

coreMemory.directSynonym: get /ˈɡɛt/（收到）；obtain /əbˈteɪn/（获得）；accept /ækˈsɛpt/（接受）；welcome /ˈwɛlkəm/（迎接）；collect /kəˈlɛkt/（领取）
coreMemory.directAntonym: send /ˈsɛnd/（发送）；refuse /rəˈfjuːz/（拒收；拒绝接受）；return /rɪˈtɝːn/（退回；归还）

fixedPhrases.example: I received a message confirming the appointment.
fixedPhrases.translation: 我收到了一条确认预约的消息。

fixedPhrases.example: She received a letter from her former teacher in June.
fixedPhrases.translation: 她六月收到了以前老师的来信。

fixedPhrases.example: Small suppliers must receive payment within thirty days.
fixedPhrases.translation: 小型供应商必须在三十天内收到付款。

fixedPhrases.example: The scientist received an award for her work on clean energy.
fixedPhrases.translation: 这位科学家因清洁能源研究获得了奖项。

fixedPhrases.example: The injured cyclist received treatment at the scene.
fixedPhrases.translation: 受伤的骑车人在现场接受了治疗。

fixedPhrases.example: The team received permission to examine the archive.
fixedPhrases.translation: 团队获准查阅档案。

fixedPhrases.example: The visiting musicians received a warm welcome from the village.
fixedPhrases.translation: 来访的音乐家受到了村民的热烈欢迎。

fixedPhrases.example: The airline received numerous complaints about the cancellation.
fixedPhrases.translation: 航空公司收到了大量有关航班取消的投诉。

fixedPhrases.example: Applicants will receive information about the interview by email.
fixedPhrases.translation: 申请人将通过电子邮件收到面试相关信息。

fixedPhrases.example: Customers should contact the supplier if they do not receive the equipment in good condition.
fixedPhrases.translation: 顾客如果收到的设备有损坏，应联系供应商。

fixedPhrases.example: The mayor received foreign guests at city hall.
fixedPhrases.translation: 市长在市政厅接待了外宾。

fixedPhrases.example: No one was home to receive the package yesterday.
fixedPhrases.translation: 昨天家里没人签收包裹。

synonyms.difference: 最常见口语表达，范围很广；receive 较正式，并突出成为传递动作的接收方。
强调通过努力或程序取得；receive 不要求付出努力或经过主动获取程序。
强调愿意接收，与被动收到不同；receive 不表示同意，收到后仍可拒绝接受。
对应友好接待来访者；receive 可正式接见来宾，不必表达热情欢迎。
强调亲自取走已准备好的物品；receive 可由邮件或快递送达，不要求亲自领取。

antonyms.usage: 在信息或物品传递方向上相对；receive 位于传递终点，send 则从来源把信息或物品发出。
只在接收所提供事物的义项上相对：receive 表示收下，refuse 表示明确不收。
只在物品流转上相对：receive 表示物品到手，return 表示把该物品送回来源处。

derivatives.note: 可指收取物品的人、电话听筒或信号接收设备。
常指邮件、款项、奖项或服务的接受者。
可指接待处、信号接收或公众反应。
常见于 proof of receipt 和 sales receipt。
常用 be receptive to ideas。

confusables.difference: receive /rɪˈsiːv/ 表示收到；deceive /dɪˈsiːv/ 表示欺骗，两词结尾相同但前缀和含义不同。
receive 表示从别人处收到，retrieve 表示主动找回或从系统检索；拼写相近但动作来源不同。

coreMemory.commonError: ❌ The decision bases on evidence. → ✅ The decision is based on evidence.；❌ We based on last year’s figures. → ✅ We based our estimate on last year’s figures.

synonyms.difference: ground 常用 be grounded in，强调证据或原则提供根基；base 更常用 base A on B，也能表示把业务设在某地。
强调确定机构或设施的物理地点；base 还可强调业务从某地运营，不只是确定坐标。
常指把人员或设备安排在某地；base 可用于公司或业务，station 更常用于人员设备。
situate 较正式，常用 be situated in 描述物理位置；base 还强调人员或组织从该地运营。
root 常用 be rooted in 说明历史、文化或原因上的深层根源；base 可指当下决策的直接依据。

antonyms.usage: 只与 base a decision on evidence 的依据义相对；disregard 表示作决定时不考虑同一证据。
只与 base staff/operations at a place 的驻地义相对；relocate 表示把人员或业务迁离该地点。
只与 base a claim on evidence 的依据义相对；leave unsupported 表示没有为同一主张提供证据基础。

derivatives.note: 不规则词形，常用 on the basis of。
常见于 evidence-based、London-based 等复合表达。
表示最重要或最简单的层面。
常修饰 claim、accusation 和 rumor。
用于概括核心事实或说明大致情况。

confusables.difference: 表示低音时 bass 与 base 同音；base 指基础或以……为依据。
base /beɪs/ 表示以……为依据；bias /ˈbaɪəs/ 表示使判断偏向一方，拼写相近但发音和作用不同。

coreMemory.chinese: 选择；挑选；采；摘；拿起；接取；撬开（锁）；辨认；分辨；入选者；首选
coreMemory.english: v. to choose someone or something from a group；v. to remove a flower, fruit, or leaf by hand；v. to take someone or something up or collect them；v. to open a lock without its key by using a small tool；v. to recognize or separate a sound, pattern, or detail from its surroundings；n. the person or thing selected as the best or preferred choice
coreMemory.structure: pick a winner /ˈpɪk ə ˈwɪnɚ/（选出获胜者）；pick a number /ˈpɪk ə ˈnʌmbɚ/（选一个数字）；pick a color /ˈpɪk ə ˈkʌlɚ/（选择颜色）；pick fresh berries /ˈpɪk ˈfrɛʃ ˈbɛriz/（采摘新鲜浆果）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ I will pick you at the station. → ✅ I will pick you up at the station.；❌ She picked out it for the ceremony. → ✅ She picked it out for the ceremony.

commonErrors.wrong: I will pick you at the station.
commonErrors.wrongPhonetic: /ˈaɪ ˈwɪl ˈpɪk ˈjuː ˈæt ðə ˈsteɪʃən/
commonErrors.right: I will pick you up at the station.
commonErrors.rightPhonetic: /ˈaɪ ˈwɪl ˈpɪk ˈjuː ˈʌp ˈæt ðə ˈsteɪʃən/
commonErrors.note: 表示开车接某人要用 pick someone up。

commonErrors.wrong: She picked out it for the ceremony.
commonErrors.wrongPhonetic: /ˈʃiː ˈpɪkt ˈaʊt ˈɪt ˈfɔːr ðə ˈsɛrəˌmoʊni/
commonErrors.right: She picked it out for the ceremony.
commonErrors.rightPhonetic: /ˈʃiː ˈpɪkt ˈɪt ˈaʊt ˈfɔːr ðə ˈsɛrəˌmoʊni/
commonErrors.note: 代词作 pick out 的宾语时，必须放在 pick 与 out 之间。

coreMemory.directSynonym: choose /ˈtʃuːz/（选择）；select /səˈlɛkt/（挑选）；pluck /ˈplʌk/（采摘）；collect /kəˈlɛkt/（接取）；nominate /ˈnɑmənət/（选定）
coreMemory.directAntonym: reject /rɪˈdʒɛkt/（拒绝选用；淘汰）；put down /ˈpʊt ˈdaʊn/（放下）；lock /ˈlɑk/（锁上；使无法开启）
coreMemory.example: Read every choice before you pick an option.
coreMemory.exampleChinese: 选择前把每个选项都读一遍。

meanings.english: to choose someone or something from a group
meanings.example: Pick the option that best fits your needs.
meanings.translation: 请选择最符合你需要的选项。

meanings.english: to remove a flower, fruit, or leaf by hand
meanings.example: They picked apples in the orchard.
meanings.translation: 他们在果园里摘苹果。

meanings.english: to take someone or something up or collect them
meanings.example: I will pick you up outside the station.
meanings.translation: 我会在车站外接你。

meanings.english: to open a lock without its key by using a small tool
meanings.example: A locksmith picked the lock without damaging the door.
meanings.translation: 锁匠没有损坏门就撬开了锁。

meanings.english: to recognize or separate a sound, pattern, or detail from its surroundings
meanings.example: She picked out the flute melody from the orchestra.
meanings.translation: 她从管弦乐声中辨认出了长笛旋律。

meanings.english: the person or thing selected as the best or preferred choice
meanings.example: This compact camera is our top pick for travel.
meanings.translation: 这款紧凑型相机是我们的旅行首选。

items.chinese: 选一个大家都方便的日期

fixedPhrases.example: A panel of five judges will pick the winner.
fixedPhrases.translation: 由五名评委组成的小组选出获胜者。

fixedPhrases.example: Pick a number between one and twenty.
fixedPhrases.translation: 请在一到二十之间选一个数字。

fixedPhrases.example: We picked a warm gray color for the kitchen walls.
fixedPhrases.translation: 我们为厨房墙面选了暖灰色。

fixedPhrases.example: The children picked fresh berries on the farm.
fixedPhrases.translation: 孩子们在农场采摘了新鲜浆果。

fixedPhrases.example: A locksmith picked the lock without damaging the door.
fixedPhrases.translation: 锁匠没有损坏门就把锁打开了。

fixedPhrases.example: I stopped at the post office to pick up a parcel.
fixedPhrases.translation: 我去邮局取了一个包裹。

fixedPhrases.example: The taxi will pick up a passenger outside the hotel at nine.
fixedPhrases.translation: 出租车九点会在酒店外接一名乘客。

fixedPhrases.example: She picked out a blue dress for the ceremony.
fixedPhrases.translation: 她为典礼挑选了一条蓝色连衣裙。

fixedPhrases.example: He could pick out the tune despite the background noise.
fixedPhrases.translation: 尽管有背景噪声，他仍能辨认出那段曲调。

fixedPhrases.example: Pick your words carefully when giving sensitive feedback.
fixedPhrases.translation: 提出敏感反馈时要仔细斟酌措辞。

fixedPhrases.example: The customer seemed determined to pick a fight with the waiter.
fixedPhrases.translation: 那位顾客似乎执意要和服务员起冲突。

fixedPhrases.example: She picked at her food because she was worried about the exam.
fixedPhrases.translation: 她担心考试，没胃口，只是拨弄着食物吃了几口。

synonyms.difference: 最通用的选择动词；pick 更口语，也可表示采摘或拿起。
较正式，暗示按标准筛选；pick 不一定依据正式标准，常是个人快速选择。
强调用手从茎、枝或表面拔下；pick 还可表示从一组对象中选择，不只从植物取下。
只对应 pick up 某人或物；pick up 才常指接人取物；单独 pick 另有选择和采摘义。
指正式提名人担任职位或获奖；pick 可选物也可选人，不一定构成正式提名。

antonyms.usage: 只与 pick/select a candidate or option 的选择义相对；reject 表示明确不选同一候选项。
只与 pick up 表示拿起的义项相对；put down 表示把同一物体从手中放回表面。
只与 pick a lock 表示无钥匙开锁的义项相对；lock 表示把同一扇门或锁具重新锁住。

derivatives.note: 指采摘作物的人或挑选物品的人。
常见于 fruit picking 和 order picking。
指对食物或选择要求过多的特点。
常见于 picky eater。

confusables.difference: pick /pɪk/ 表示挑选、采摘或拿取；peck /pɛk/ 表示鸟用喙啄，或快速轻吻。
pick 可泛指选择或采摘；pick out 强调从一组中挑出或在人群中辨认，不能省略 out 后保持所有义项。
